options: Every summons shall be served by an excise personnel, or subject to such rules as the State Government may make in this behalf, by an officer of the Court issuing it or other public servant.

Every summons shall be served by a police officer, or subject to such rules as the State Government may make in this behalf, by an officer of the Court issuing it or other public servant.
Every summons shall be served by a police officer, or subject to such rules as the Union Government may make in this behalf, by an officer of the Court issuing it or other public servant.
